visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man wearing a white t-shirt and black pants stands in a bright indoor room next to an older woman wearing a white frilly long-sleeved blouse. The room features pale yellow walls, a large window with a decorative metal grate, and a white wall-mounted air conditioner. A small circular black metal table adorned with warm white string lights is positioned between them. The man smiles and gestures expansively with both hands while the woman watches him attentively. (2) The shot cuts to a close-up of the man, now in a black crew-neck sweatshirt, speaking directly into the lens in a bedroom with a lavender-colored bedspread. He raises his right index finger for emphasis. The scene then shifts back to the main room where the woman is seated on a chair draped in white fabric at a white vanity table with a circular mirror. The man stands nearby, observing her as she touches the furniture. (3) The video transitions through several family photographs shown as still frames. One photo displays a large family group of seven people posing in a formal living room. Another photo is a nostalgic, slightly grainy shot of the woman and a man holding a young child, likely the narrator. The man and woman in the photo are smiling widely, and the woman points towards the camera. (4) The scene returns to the bright indoor room where the woman stands by the window, clapping her hands and laughing. The man in the white t-shirt joins in the laughter, leaning forward with high energy and a broad grin. The final frame is a clear photograph of the woman standing by a waterfront railing during a golden-hour sunset, wearing a light blue blouse, a yellow crossbody bag, and sunglasses.
